description:
UE5 CURVE EDITOR SECRETS: Buffer Curves & Mass Keyframe Polishing: Focus on crucial Keyframe Curve Editor tools for safe and efficient editing in Unreal Engine. You will utilize Buffer Curves as a crucial animation snapshot for comparing or quickly reversing destructive changes. Apply the Euler filter to fix rotation problems like gimbal lock, and leverage powerful mass editing tools like the bake tool (for density reduction) and the smooth/rough tween tool for polishing complex motion data like mocap

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to explore how OddBot embraced real-time animation in Unreal Engine to create Disney Junior’s ‘Playdate with Winnie the Pooh’—and discovered a more collaborative, creative, and fun way to produce animation.

When the folks at Emmy-winning and Annie-nominated animation studio OddBot partnered with Disney Junior to create Playdate with Winnie the Pooh, they decided to take a bold new approach, transitioning from a traditional CG animation pipeline to one based on real-time production in Unreal Engine.

Find out how that decision uncovered an innovative way of making children’s animation—one that enhances collaboration, creativity, and speed without sacrificing charm.

Season three of “Playdate with Winnie the Pooh” premiered on Disney Jr. on January 17 and next day on Disney+

#RealTimeAnimation, #PlaydateWithWinnieThePooh, #UnrealEngine, #OddBot, #DisneyJunior
title: OddBot reinvents its animation pipeline for ‘Playdate with Winnie the Pooh’
